description: Get an itemized price for 1-10 pages or count a base64 PDF. Quoting is free. Unknown input fields are rejected with invalid_request; error.fix names each unknown field and the accepted fields. For a return receipt, use service certified_err. One page costs $9.04 for certified or $12.24 with an electronic Return Receipt; use quote_letter for the exact page count. Quoting never creates, pays for or mails a letter. No refund once USPS accepts the letter, even if USPS can't deliver it. If the person mentioned a deadline, compare it with the delivery estimate and tell them plainly when the estimate falls after it. Example: {"pages":1,"service":"certified"}

pages.description: Page count from 1 to 10. Provide exactly one of pages or pdf_base64; omit pages when providing a PDF.

pdf_base64.description: A base64-encoded PDF whose pages we count for the quote. Provide exactly one of pages or pdf_base64; omit pages when providing a PDF. Neither field takes precedence: sending both is rejected, even if the counts agree.

name: quote_letter

partner_cost_cents.description: Public printing-and-postage cost in USD cents. The itemized price adds a 10% service fee; total_cents is before any Stripe sales tax.

title: Quote a certified letter
